Waaree Renewable Technologies

The EXIT call was given in July 2024—precisely 2 years ago.

Back then, almost nobody had the conviction to say "Forget this stock."

After an unbelievable 2,00,000% rally, the crowd was busy chasing dreams.
We chose to follow Price.

Fast forward two years...
📉 ~70% down from the highs.
And here's the interesting part...

Even after a 70% crash, the stock is still nowhere close to completing even a 25% proportional correction of its historic rally.

That's the difference between looking at percentages and understanding Price Structure.

A stock can fall 70%, 80%, or even 90%... and still remain structurally expensive after a parabolic multi-year move.

It may take close to a decade before this chart builds a meaningful long-term opportunity again.
Until then...

"Gayi Bhains Bhaad Mein!" 😄

The market doesn't reward loyalty to a stock.
It rewards loyalty to Price.

E2E NETWORK

Study shared near 180 now 460+ 🔥 

Everyone is talking about E2E Networks 330% revenue growth.

I was listening for something else.

One sentence from the management changed my perspective.

"We are at Day Zero of a decadal AI super cycle."

That statement explains almost everything.

Here's why. 🧵👇

1️⃣ Revenue didn't grow because of one-time pricing.

Management clarified that growth was primarily driven by higher GPU utilization and capacity expansion.

That's a healthier growth engine.

2️⃣ Demand remains stronger than supply.

The existing NVIDIA B200 GPU cluster is already operating at maximum utilization.

Another 1,024 B200 GPUs are expected in the coming months.

The company is expanding because customers already exist not because it hopes they will.

3️⃣ Pricing power is visible.

Hardware costs increased.

E2E raised prices.

Yet demand remained robust.

At the same time, the company is offering long-term contracts that allow customers to lock in pricing.

That's how infrastructure businesses build revenue visibility.

4️⃣ The L&T partnership deserves more attention.

L&T provides data centre capacity.

E2E provides AI cloud infrastructure.

Instead of building everything from scratch, the company is leveraging partnerships to scale faster.

5️⃣ The biggest takeaway wasn't this quarter's numbers.

It was the vision.

Management wants to build a Sovereign AI Cloud Platform, where enterprises can deploy AI models securely within India.

If AI becomes critical infrastructure, sovereign AI infrastructure could become equally important.

330% growth grabs headlines.

The AI infrastructure being built today could define the next decade.

That's what I'm studying.
